name: polystrata
description: High-performance 2D polygon clipping, Boolean operations, and topological healing kernel powered by Rust/WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path crates/polystrata-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('crates/polystrata-wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/polystrata_wasm.wasm');fs.writeFileSync('src/wasm-bytes.ts','// Auto-generated from crates/polystrata-wasm\nexport const WASM_BASE64: string = \"'+b.toString('base64')+'\";\n');"
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.cts')"
